draft.title: Avatar upload corrupts PNGs

draft.body:
The thumbnailer rewrites the alpha channel.

![after](.pmngr/attachments/ACME-T-0077/after.png "after the fix")

warnings: Assignee: Contractor Without Login: the assignee "Contractor Without Login" came back without a login, so its display name was used as the handle
Fix versions: 1.4.3: the issue is assigned to several versions; "1.5.0" was kept as the milestone and "1.4.3" ignored
